results.title: About Heavy Menstrual Bleeding | Bleeding Disorders in Women | CDC
results.passage: Have a menstrual flow that soaks through one or more pads or tampons every hour for several hours in a row. Have a menstrual flow with blood clots the size of a quarter or larger.
